summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (`ipns-signature-verify-coverage`) of the CipherBox project — a backend crypto/security phase adding IPNS signature verification coverage across Rust (FUSE crate), TypeScript (sdk-core), and cross-language test vectors.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans were created and verified (0 blockers), and 3 of 4 plans were executed by end of transcript (58-01 CBOR chokepoint, 58-02 D-09 sequence gate, 58-03 web dedup) with 58-04 (cross-language vectors) still in flight.

repo: Phase 58 has a dependency cycle constraint: `crates/crypto` cannot dev-depend on `api-client/core`, so cross-language test vectors must live in `crates/fuse/tests/` instead of `crates/crypto/tests/`.
The IPNS verification chokepoint is `resolve_ipns_verified` in `crates/fuse/src/verify.rs`; 9 FUSE resolve sites needed routing through it (events/fs/metadata/publish/replay paths).
Non-CAS embedded-sequence validation (D-09 gate in `upsertFolderIpns`) is the highest-risk change class — it previously broke 48/89 SDK E2E tests.
The D-09 gate uses an idempotent-no-increment-but-update-latestCid branch for the sequence enforcement logic.
After 58-01: core=75, fuse=87, sdk-core vitest=235 tests passing. After 58-02: api jest=913/913.
Web resolve dedup (D-13): web delegates to sdk-core, 14 callers unaffected.
The local dev stack (redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo) was running and required for 58-02's E2E gate.

code.finding: `ciborium` is a declared dependency of the fuse crate — a mid-execution diagnostic falsely flagged it as missing due to stale state during a partial write.
`expectedSequenceNumber` guard at this line is the CAS 409 conflict check — intentionally preserved and not part of the D-09 non-CAS sequence gate.

workflow: Sequential execution on the feature branch is safer than parallel worktree execution for security/crypto phases — avoids cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees.
The GSD commit helper has a known false-negative: `commit_failed` can be reported even when the commit lands. Always verify with `git log` rather than retrying.
RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` sections should have `(RESOLVED)` inline markers after questions are addressed in-plan; the plan checker flags missing markers as a warning.
Subagent socket disconnection can leave partial work (uncommitted diffs) mid-task requiring a continuation prompt with explicit remaining-task scope.
A spawned executor can over-run its assigned plan scope and complete the next sequential plan in the same run — verify git state and SUMMARY files to determine true completion count.

friction: 58-01 executor died mid-task-4 (API socket connection closed), leaving Task 3 (FUSE resolve-site routing, 5 files) done but uncommitted and Task 4 (sdk-core JS binding) not started — required a manual continuation subagent.

58-02's full-SDK-E2E gate silently skipped: the API on :3000 was running from compiled dist with a mismatched `TEST_LOGIN_SECRET`, causing test-login to 401. This is the exact change-class that previously broke 48/89 tests, making the skip high-risk.
58-02 executor over-ran and also executed 58-03 in the same subagent run, complicating per-plan tracking and checkpoint recording.
Plan checker flagged RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` missing `(RESOLVED)` marker as a warning, requiring a direct file edit to avoid a full planner revision cycle.
open_items: 58-04 (cross-language verify vectors, 7 cases, Rust + sdk-core, D-11/D-12) was still executing at transcript end.
58-02's SDK E2E gate needs a proper run during phase verification with the correct `TEST_LOGIN_SECRET` — the change-class risk (previously 48/89 broken) means this cannot remain skipped.
